global.name: Name
global.access_denied: This operation is not permitted for this account or portal.

global.page_diagnostics_help: Inspect your browser environment and the connected server.
global.saved: Preferences are saved on this device.
global.token_payload_help: Explore the session claims returned by AuthCrunch. Expand objects and arrays to inspect their contents.
global.token_payload_note: Viewing claims does not verify a token signature.
global.token_payload_error: This payload cannot be displayed as a tree. You can still show or copy the original value.
global.token_method_other: An authentication method defined by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_amr: Authentication Methods References: the methods used to sign in. Several methods can appear together.
global.token_claim_acr: Authentication Context Class Reference: the assurance context assigned by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_iss: Issuer: the service that issued the token.
global.token_claim_sub: Subject: the identity this token represents.
global.token_claim_aud: Audience: the services this token is intended for.
global.token_claim_exp: Expiration time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_iat: Issued-at time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_nbf: Not-before time: the token is not valid before this Unix timestamp.
global.token_claim_auth_time: When authentication occurred, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_jti: Token identifier: a unique identifier for this token.
global.token_claim_sid: Session identifier: the sign-in session associated with this token.
global.token_claim_roles: Effective roles carried by the session.
global.token_claim_authenticated: Authentication status reported by the portal.
global.token_claim_expires_at_utc: Expiration time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_issued_at_utc: Issue time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_not_before_utc: Not-before time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_method_otp: A one-time code, such as a code from an authenticator app.
global.token_method_hwk: Proof of possession of a hardware-protected key.
global.token_method_swk: Proof of possession of a software-protected key.
global.token_method_federated: Sign-in through an external identity provider.
global.token_method_user: A check that the user is physically present.
profile.page_api_keys_help: Manage the keys your applications use to access protected services.
profile.page_ssh_keys_help: Keep your SSH public keys and their fingerprints in one place.
profile.page_gpg_keys_help: Manage the public keys associated with your identity.
profile.page_authenticators_help: Set up authenticator apps, passkeys, and security keys for signing in.
profile.page_user_info_help: Your account information, password, and identity details.
profile.page_connected_accounts_help: Review the accounts linked to your identity.
profile.login_intro: Choose how you sign in to this local account. Changes apply to future logins.
profile.login_portal_notice: This flow is selected by the server for your current connection. Portal policy can replace your account rules or add required steps.
profile.login_defaults_help: Remove your custom rules and let AuthCrunch choose the default flow from your enrolled methods. Portal requirements still apply.
profile.login_preset_prefer_passkey: Prefer passkey, with authenticator app and password fallbacks
profile.login_rules_help: Rules are tried from top to bottom. A sequence requires every method in order. Alternatives select the first enrolled method, rather than asking you to choose. Fallbacks depend on enrollment, not a failed sign-in attempt.
profile.login_conditions: Only when all these methods are unavailable
profile.login_preview_help: Preview based on your currently enrolled methods. The server checks portal requirements when you save; the effective flow may differ.
profile.login_invalid: Each rule needs distinct methods. Alternatives need at least two methods. Remove duplicate rules.
profile.login_no_match: These rules cannot select a usable flow with your enrolled methods. Enroll a missing method or adjust your rules.
profile.login_confirm_help: Saving replaces all your account login rules and invalidates your current sign-in. You will sign in again using the resulting flow. Portal requirements remain in effect.
profile.login_save_error: The server could not apply these rules. Your enrolled methods or portal policy may have changed. Reload the current policy or revise your rules.
profile.login_save_uncertain: The save result could not be confirmed. Reload the current policy before trying again; you may need to sign in again.
profile.error: Unable to complete this request. Check your connection and try again.
profile.delete_description: These credentials will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
profile.empty_help: Create a credential or adjust your filters.
profile.title: Title
profile.validate_help: Complete the required fields and verify the credential before continuing.
profile.api_help: Use 64–72 letters and numbers. Save a copy before creating this key; it will not be shown again.
profile.copy_error: Copy failed. Select and copy the text manually.
profile.public_key_help: Paste a public key or import a text file, then test it before continuing.
profile.qr_help: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or copy the setup link. Enter the code to verify.
profile.webauthn_help: Use a passkey on your device or a security key. Register it, then verify it when your browser prompts you.
profile.unsupported: WebAuthn requires a supported browser and a secure connection.
profile.password_help: Use 8–254 characters. Both new password fields must match.
profile.name: Name
profile.token_help: This token is sensitive. Reveal it only when needed.
profile.not_found_help: The page you requested is unavailable. Return to your dashboard.
profile.welcome: Manage your identity and account security.
profile.database_help: The API returns demonstration database metadata; these values do not describe deployment storage.
profile.key_title_help: 3–100 letters, numbers, spaces, underscore, @, dot, or parentheses.
profile.gpg_title_help: 3–100 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces and @ . _ ( ) < > , - + : are supported.
profile.description_help: Leave empty or use 3–255 letters, numbers, spaces, underscore, comma, dot, or hyphen.
